STS2_THINGS-BOSS_ONLY_MOD_BOSSES.hover.d: Choose only enabled bosses from this mod in their supported acts. If none are available, keep the original boss pool. Forced bosses take priority. Existing maps are not rerolled.
STS2_THINGS-MULTIPLAYER_POLICY: Multiplayer settings follow the host. Gameplay locks when the run starts; the host can still change music. Leaving restores your preferences.
THINGS_CROSSROADS_DESCRIPTION: A few locked side paths appear on the map. Reach either end to unlock one (50 / 100 / 150 Gold in Acts 1 / 2 / 3). In multiplayer, every player must pay the toll; the entire party gains access.

STS2_THINGS-STABILITY.title: Engine Safety
STS2_THINGS-FEATURE_DEFENSIVE_ENGINE_GUA: Prevents hover-tip viewport clipping, pooled card texture leaks, and combat teardown race conditions without altering vanilla gameplay.
THINGS_STARTUP_NOTICE.title: Things: Bug Reports
THINGS_STARTUP_NOTICE.body:
Thanks for playing [gold]STS2 Things[/gold]!

If you run into a bug with the mod, press [gold]F2[/gold] and choose [gold]Things Bug (upload run)[/gold]. A quick note about what happened is plenty.

Your run route and combat state go along with the report to help the author track it down. If it does not send, you can try again later with [gold]Things Bug (retry pending)[/gold] in F2.

Thanks for the heads-up, and enjoy your climb!
